ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme: A deeper dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the arrest of Abdikerm Eidleh and the extent of the scheme
ideas.angle: The investigative angle would focus on the perpetrators and the scope of the scheme
questions: What was the extent of the scheme?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme is a significant case that involves allegations of conspiracy to commit wire fraud and money laundering. The arrest of Abdikerm Eidleh in Somalia is a major development in the case.
